page.layout: One printed title page on the scan. Title block at the top, a woodcut device in the centre, and an imprint line with a date below it. A dark ghost text in the upper left and a mirrored line lower right look like show-through from the other side of the leaf.
page.notes: The scan is very faint and heavily show-through. The title lines at the top, the rotated "Scholia" fragment at the top right, and the imprint line are too faint or mirrored to read reliably, so I have not transcribed them. The imprint line near the bottom appears mirrored and includes a Roman date that looks like MDLXXVII, but I cannot confirm it, so it is not given here. The woodcut device in the centre has no printed text inside it. A higher-resolution or differently lit scan of the recto would be needed to transcribe the title accurately.
